Part classes, state attributes and color properties are public and versioned. In a state, values lists what the attribute takes; "" is an attribute set without a value, and an empty list one that takes any value or is selected by its presence alone. colors lists the custom properties that set a component’s colors on one instance, through style or CSS; they don’t inherit.
